# Granite Recovery Centers

> > Granite Recovery Centers provides evidence-based addiction treatment and mental health services across New Hampshire, specializing in medication-assisted treatment, detox, and comprehensive recovery programs.

Granite Recovery Centers operates multiple facilities including Harmony House and Freedom House in New Hampshire, offering FDA-approved medication-assisted treatment (MAT) with medications like Naltrexone and Baclofen, alongside behavioral health services for substance use disorders, prescription drug abuse, and co-occurring mental health conditions.

## Key Topics

- Substance use disorder treatment
- Medication-assisted treatment (MAT)
- Alcohol use disorder
- Prescription drug abuse
- Stimulant abuse (methylphenidate, cocaine)
- Addiction recovery programs
- Brain reward center and neurotransmitters
- Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT)
- Medical detox services
- Aftercare and relapse prevention
- Co-occurring mental health disorders
- FDA-approved addiction medications
- New Hampshire behavioral health services
- Sober living programs
- Teen substance abuse prevention

## Treatment Programs & Services

- [NH's Best Aftercare Program](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/behavioral-services/aftercare): Three-phase aftercare program with sober living and relapse prevention
- [Ritalin Abuse: Addiction Signs & Treatment](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/addiction-treatment-programs/ritalin-rehab): Ritalin addiction signs and methylphenidate treatment program details
- [Medical Detox vs. Medication-Assisted Treatment](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/medical-detox-vs-medication-assisted-treatment): Compares medical detox and MAT approaches for addiction treatment

## Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)

- [Naltrexone](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/behavioral-services/medication-assisted-treatment/naltrexone): FDA-approved Naltrexone for opioid and alcohol use disorder treatment
- [Baclofen and Its Uses in Treating Addiction](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/behavioral-services/medication-assisted-treatment/baclofen): Details Baclofen muscle relaxant for alcohol use disorder treatment

## Insurance & Coverage

- [Well Sense](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/insurance-coverage/wellsense): WellSense Medicaid coverage for NH behavioral health treatment

## Addiction Science & Mental Health

- [How Endorphins Affect Addiction and Recovery](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/drug-and-alcohol-addiction/how-endorphins-affect-addiction-and-recovery): Explains endorphins' role in brain reward center and addiction recovery
- [Cognitive Distortions and Addiction](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/mental-health/cognitive-distortions-and-addiction): Explores negative thinking patterns and CBT in addiction recovery
- [Depression and Xanax](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/link-between-xanax-and-depression): Examines how Xanax benzodiazepine affects depression symptoms

## Drug Interactions & Safety

- [Dangers of Mixing Cocaine and Viagra](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/dangers-of-mixing-viagra-and-cocaine): Covers cardiovascular risks of mixing cocaine with Viagra (sextacy)
- [Dangers of Mixing Concerta and Alcohol](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/dangers-of-mixing-concerta-with-alcohol): Methylphenidate-alcohol interaction risks and stimulant abuse dangers
- [Dangers of Mixing Trazodone and Alcohol](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/dangers-of-mixing-trazodone-with-alcohol): Trazodone antidepressant and alcohol interaction side effects
- [Cymbalta Half-Life: How Long It Stays in Your System](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/how-long-is-cymbalta-in-your-body): Duloxetine half-life, clearance timeline, and withdrawal management

## Recovery Resources & Education

- [Habits of Happy People in Sobriety](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/habits-of-happy-people-in-sobriety): Lifestyle habits and positive mindset strategies for recovery success
- [Long-term Effects of Teen Vaping](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/behavioral-services/teenagers/long-term-effects-of-teen-vaping-infographic): CDC-based infographic on teen vaping and nicotine addiction risks
- [Slang Names for Heroin](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/slang-names-for-heroin): Educational guide to heroin street terminology and slang terms
- [Drinking on the Job](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/resources/dangers-of-drinking-on-the-job): Workplace drinking consequences and alcohol addiction treatment options
- [Can You Be Addicted to CBD?](https://www.graniterecoverycenters.com/addiction-treatment-programs/cbd-rehab): Explains CBD vs THC differences and cannabidiol addiction potential
